name: labs/kzhao1228__pystage_apt
title: Thorlabs APT stage controller (pystage-apt)
intro: Thorlabs APT stage controller (pystage-apt), adapted from kzhao1228/pystage_apt. It reads `in_motion`, `homed`, `channel_enabled`, `forward_limit_active` and 6 more; sets `position`, `maximum_velocity`, `acceleration`, `home_direction` and 1 more; runs `home`, `move_relative` and `stop_motion`. `home`: drive axes to their declared home position or reference switch, establishing the coordinate reference needed by other motion capabilities. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
